About Me

I'm Daanish Sohail, a final-year Electrical Engineering student majoring in Computer Engineering at FAST NUCES, Faisalabad. My work lives at the intersection of artificial intelligence, embedded hardware, and physical design.

What sets me apart is that I don't just write code — I build complete systems. From firmware on a microcontroller, to training an NLP model, to 3D printing the enclosure that houses it all. My FYP — an AI-powered receptionist robot — brings all of these together on a single edge device.

I've interned at DSG Energy (power electronics, hardware testing) and Alpha-Beta Technology (robotics, sensor integration), giving me real industrial experience alongside my academic foundation.

MATLAB & Data Science

Machine learning, signal processing, statistical analysis, and neural network projects built in MATLAB and Minitab. From medical image classification to industrial process optimization.
🧠 MATLAB · Deep Learning
Brain Tumor MRI Detection
Deep learning model for MRI brain tumor classification into 4 categories: Glioma, Meningioma, No Tumor, and Pituitary. Achieved 98.12% validation accuracy using transfer learning.
MATLABDeep LearningTransfer LearningMRI Classification
👁️ MATLAB · CNN
Diabetic Retinopathy Detection
CNN-based retinal image classifier for early detection of diabetic retinopathy. Trained over 10 epochs achieving 64.14% validation accuracy on medical imaging dataset.
MATLABCNNComputer VisionMedical AI
⚡ MATLAB · ML GUI
Air Compressor Fault Detection
Audio-based ML fault classifier with interactive MATLAB GUI. Classifies 8 fault types: Bearing, Flywheel, Healthy, LIV, LOV, NRV, Piston, and Riderbelt from audio waveforms.
MATLABMLAudio SignalGUI AppFault Detection
🔬 MATLAB · ML
Skin Lesion Classification
Multi-class skin lesion image classifier. Classifies lesion types including df, akiec, bkl, nv, and mel categories using machine learning on dermoscopic images.
MATLABImage ClassificationMedical AIDermatology
📊 MATLAB · ANN
ANN Surface Roughness Prediction
Artificial Neural Network regression for SiC surface roughness prediction. Compared 3 algorithms (LM, Bayesian, SCG) across 9 configurations. Levenberg-Marquardt with 10 neurons achieved R=0.98.
MATLABANNLM AlgorithmRegressionR=0.98
📈 Minitab · DOE
Surface Roughness — Minitab Analysis
Full factorial design (2³) + GLM/ANOVA + Response Optimizer in Minitab for CNC turning surface roughness. Feed Rate dominates 85% variance. Optimal: Speed=260, Feed=0.08, Depth=0.8 → Ra=0.98μm.
MinitabFactorial DOEANOVAResponse Optimizer
🏭 Minitab · Taguchi
Taguchi Injection Molding Optimization
L9 Orthogonal Array Taguchi optimization to minimize warping defects in plastic injection molding. Injection Pressure contributes 75.8% variance. Optimal: Mold=220°C, Pressure=100MPa, Cooling=20s.
MinitabTaguchi L9ANOVAInjection Molding
